origin: New original HEALTHMON species designed for this trial; no image references from Lucan, Mongle or Tori
identity: Serak is an original upright amphibian sacred beast of starlit springs. It has smooth deep midnight-teal skin, an exposed pale jade abdomen, warm copper-amber eyes, a short broad amphibian muzzle, three small pearl forehead spots in a triangle, two translucent lavender crescent-shaped head fins and a single long balancing tail with a broad lavender-and-teal paddle fin. Two free arms end in rounded three-digit hands; two powerful hind legs end in broad three-toed feet. Natural pale teal luminous current markings run along the skin. Its fins and markings are living anatomy.
anatomy_constraint: Exactly one complete upright biped: one head, two free arms with two visible three-digit hands, two hind legs with two separate grounded three-toed feet, and one complete balancing tail held clear of the floor. The hands hang or gesture beside the torso. Keep the abdomen visible between the arms. Both feet alone support its weight.

stages.1: First evolution at level25: a capable young biped with moderate head proportions, short crescent head fins, small shoulder fin buds, a simple pale jade belly and a small paddle tail. Keep the whole anatomy relatively compact and simple, with a restrained hint of luminous spring markings; leave clear room for a substantial second evolution.
stages.2: Second evolution at level50: an established magnificent sacred-spring guardian. Develop the two head fins into elegant sweeping translucent crescent blades, the shoulder fin buds into layered natural current fins, the forearms into substantial creature arms, the hind feet into broad confident three-toed supports and the tail into a flowing paddle-finned balance organ. A smaller adult head relative to the torso, narrower expressive adult eyes, developed broad muzzle and serene commanding bearing establish maturity. Thin luminous teal current markings follow the ribs, arms and legs. These stage structures are equally developed across every lifestyle branch.
stages.3: Third evolution at level75: further mature the established sacred-spring guardian into a monumental adult. Extend its inherited flowing crescent fins, develop the face and integrated current markings, strengthen its natural shoulder and tail silhouettes, retaining the preceding branch body history. Do not add limbs or turn it into a different species.

branch_bodies.sprinter: CURRENT-LEAPER. A tall sleek upright biped with a narrow clearly defined waist, light upper arms, powerful developed hips and thighs, long spring-loaded lower legs and large streamlined hind feet. The lower body is visibly stronger than the upper body. Its mature head fins sweep backward, shoulder fins follow an upward aerodynamic arc, and the long paddle tail balances an alert agile stance. Expose the lean pale jade abdomen and retain the full target-stage sacred anatomy.
branch_bodies.bulwark: TIDE-BREAKER. A broad-chested upright biped with substantially developed shoulders, thick muscular upper arms and enormous strong forearms, large free three-digit hands and a firm visible waist. The upper body is distinctly stronger than the compact supporting legs. Mature shoulder fins spread in a broad horizontal layered arc while the crescent head fins and paddle tail retain the same stage development. Firm muscle transitions and a flat supported abdomen convey strength.
branch_bodies.balanced_athlete: ALL-CURRENT ATHLETE. A proportionate upright biped with evenly developed shoulders, arms, hips and hind legs, an athletic waist and a poised grounded stance. Develop the full mature crescent head fins, natural current shoulder fins and paddle tail in balanced flowing proportions.
branch_bodies.balanced_ranger: SPRINGWARDEN. An elegant upright biped with an evenly proportioned torso, moderate arms and thighs, a gently defined ordinary waist and medium-length legs. The mature head crescents rise evenly and the shoulder fins curve in a harmonious flowing arrangement. The creature has a capable composed stance and fully developed sacred anatomy without specializing in enormous arms or runner legs.
branch_bodies.restful_ranger: DEEP-POOL WATCHER. A relaxed upright biped with lowered shoulders, long lightly muscled free arms, modest thigh development, a gently curved torso and an ordinary softly rounded belly. Its medium-length legs remain clearly visible. The mature shoulder fins curve downward like quiet water, while the adult head crescents and paddle tail stay fully developed. Keep a composed dignified same-stage appearance; balanced energy intake does not create a huge obese abdomen.
branch_bodies.hearth_heavy: DEEP-TIDE BASTION. A majestic broad upright biped with an unmistakably huge exposed rounded pale jade abdomen, wide soft hips, thick thighs and short-looking weight-bearing hind legs. The soft belly projects forward and extends below the ribcage. Two free arms stay outside the belly silhouette and end in separate three-digit hands. A moderate adult head, fully developed crescent head fins, wide fanning shoulder fins and a broad paddle tail give it equal sacred-stage maturity and dignity. Its mass is visibly soft body fat, with a low center of gravity.
branch_bodies.recovery_guardian: RETURNING-TIDE GUARDIAN. An upright biped retaining the preceding heavy body's broad hips and clearly visible moderately rounded abdomen, with firmer supporting hind legs, a more lifted chest and active free arms. Retain substantial softness from its actual history while developing the same mature crescent fins and paddle tail.

stage1_branch_bodies.bulwark: A capable young upright biped with broader shoulders, strong rounded forearms and free three-digit hands, a firm waist and compact supporting hind legs; compact juvenile crescent fins and a small paddle tail.
stage1_branch_bodies.balanced_athlete: A capable young upright biped with evenly developed arms and hind legs, a narrow athletic waist, compact juvenile crescent fins and a small paddle tail.
stage1_branch_bodies.balanced_ranger: An evenly proportioned young upright biped with moderate arms, medium-length hind legs and an ordinary pale jade abdomen; compact juvenile crescent fins and a small paddle tail.
stage1_branch_bodies.restful_ranger: A relaxed young upright biped with modest muscle definition, lowered shoulders, free arms and an ordinary pale jade belly, compact juvenile crescent fins and a small paddle tail.
